name: Ping pong paddle with dual-side-friendly handle

mentions.name: Ping pong paddle with dual-side-friendly handle
mentions.description: A redesigned ping pong paddle with a custom handle shape that makes it easier to hold the correct blade angle on both the forehand and backhand sides, being iterated through 3D-printed prototypes before a functional prototype is made.
mentions.problem: Standard paddle grip styles usually favor one side of the game or the other; the author's forehand suffers while their backhand is fine.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A new ping pong paddle design.

My backhand is OK but my forehand sucks. Grip styles for standard handles usually end up favoring one side or the other. I'm making a handle shape that's easier to get the blade angle right on both sides.
